top_violation_types.title: HRC42.052(c) - AP Illegal Operation - Not Listed (26 TAC §HRC42.052(c) - AP Illegal Operation - No)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Regular care is being provided to 2 unrelated children.

top_violation_types.title: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance (26 TAC §746.203(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Provider did not submit annual verification of liability insurance timely.

top_violation_types.title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Children were observed watching mickey mouse during snack time    This was corrected during the inspection when I observed the caregiver turn off the tablet and closed it.

top_violation_types.title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders (26 TAC §746.3317(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Crackers were served on a bare table for children to eat from.

top_violation_types.title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At time of inspection an eight month infant was observed with a blanket inside the crib.   This was corrected at inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 1 child needs emergency care authorization to be redone due to water damage on form.

top_violation_types.title: Documented Annual Training - 6 Hours of annual training required (26 TAC §746.1309(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A staff person was missing 6 hours of annual training.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The school age building still had a broken electrical outlet in the library center.
